request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: A company rents out a piece of work equipment without an operator to another firm. Besides certifying its good condition, is it obliged to obtain and keep a declaration certifying the specific training of those who will use it?

response.text: {"kind": "boolean", "value": true, "text": "Yes. Under D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 72, comma 2 (DLGS72.md), a lessor of work equipment without an operator must certify its good condition, maintenance and efficiency at handover, and must also obtain and keep on file, for the whole rental or loan period, a self-certification from the renter (or the employer) attesting to the specific training and instruction of the users.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGS72.md", "place": "art. 72, c. 2", "quote": "Chiunque noleggi o conceda in uso attrezzature di lavoro senza operatore deve, al momento della cessione, attestarne il buono stato di conservazione, manutenzione ed efficienza a fini di sicurezza. ((Deve altresì acquisire e conservare agli atti, per tutta la durata del noleggio o della concessione dell'attrezzatura, una dichiarazione autocertificativa del soggetto che prende a noleggio, o in concessione in uso, o del datore di lavoro, che attesti l'avvenuta formazione e addestramento specifico, effettuati conformemente alle disposizioni del presente Titolo, dei soggetti individuati per l'utilizzo.))"}]}
